title: Truebound - Vanilla Modpack
description: Truebound – A True Vanilla Survival Experience
body:
![Truebound Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/01a2999e143074ffb23bf963b9eae7f1aae8f386.jpeg)

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/5I9x2fQbzeY" title="Reprodutor de vídeo do YouTube" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

- **_Truebound_ is a new way to experience Minecraft as it was meant to be, without losing the essence of Vanilla. This modpack expands, refines, and deepens every aspect of survival, creating a more immersive, challenging, and rewarding experience. Here, the goal isn’t to turn the game into something different-it’s to push Vanilla to its limits.**

![Bar 1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8761fe7ed953d0798123b00be67cdfef71900e13.png)

> ### The essence of Vanilla Elevad ✨

- **_Truebound_  was carefully crafted to keep the heart of Minecraft intact. No broken mechanics or forced progression—everything was designed to feel natural, as if it had always been part of the game.**
 
- **Each change preserves the original rhythm, but adds depth where there was once simplicity.**

![Bar 2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/157c8201c9d5128c702cb3b231982ed577a92fd1.png)

> ### Immersion in every detail 🍃

- **Small improvements make a big difference.**
 
- **_Truebound_ adds visual, mechanical, and audio refinements that make the game more fluid and immersive, without compromising Minecraft’s classic aesthetic. You can feel the difference, without losing that familiar feel.**

![Bar 3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/951eef3401f52fcd95169dc5bb074f9ee08c132c.png)

> ### Built for long days 🧭

- **This isn't a modpack you can just play for a few days.**

- **_Truebound_ was created for enduring worlds, where farming, building, and progression reach a whole new level. Everything has been designed to be with you for the long haul.**

![Bar 4](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0a476f7f0703e4cb6d89631ccf901df4eff2408d.png)

> ### Your world. Your story. Your survival 🌎

- **_Truebound_ doesn't set rules; it expands possibilities.**

- **If you're looking for an experience that stays true to Vanilla but is much deeper, more immersive, and longer-lasting… You've found it.**

![Truebound Banner 5](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eb87eb944ddabf5e906749c521cd29031f8bdc51.jpeg)

> ### ❗ IMPORTANT: Order of Resource Packs ❗

- **FOLLOW THE ORDER OF THE RESOURCE PACKS LISTED IN THE [LINK](https://imgur.com/a/G3qQB1v) TO ENSURE PROPER FUNCTIONING, AS WELL AS THAT OF THE MODS THAT DEPEND ON THEM. OTHERWISE, THE MODPACK MAY EXHIBIT ERRORS OR FAIL TO FUNCTION AS EXPECTED.**

![Bar 5](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2b745318499665c5671c4377d859cb48eea4afcd.png)

> ### Solutions for some possible errors/conflicts 💡

![SOLUÇÕES](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c5ead924b205d2768942dc8e37d3c05125b24c4.jpeg)

- **If you see some mist from the _Particle Rain_ mod and want to turn it off, follow these steps: Open the menu, go to “Mods,” search for the “Particle Rain” mod, click the gear icon to open the mod's settings, and uncheck the last two options in each column: “Biome-specific mist” and “Mist after rain.”.**

- **If you see a transparent rectangle over the boat, follow these steps: Go to the Resource Settings (the creeper button in the resource pack menu) > Models > All Models, find boat_patch.jeme, and disable it.**

![Bar 6](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e1761c6a4ec1bda2f3aaf0a204364708fafaf48d.png)

> ### Voxy and Chunky mods ⚙️

![Voxy](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e9ce86cb46095eafceee6dbe212da7726859cf99.jpeg)

- **To view extreme distances with the _Voxy_ mod, you must use the Chunky mod, ensuring that all terrain is loaded in advance. To do this, when entering a world, use the command _/chunky radius (number of chunks)_ to define the desired area, and then run _/chunky start_ to begin loading. A progress bar will appear on the screen; wait until all chunks have been processed for the rendering to work correctly.**

- **After completing this process, make sure that Voxy is properly enabled in the game settings and that the mod’s render distance is set correctly; we recommend using the maximum value for optimal performance. For an even cleaner and more immersive visual experience, we also recommend disabling the fog effect.**

![Bar 7](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f027cfd0663f11ca54f59954e6c0e7b1d514cf7d.png)

> ### Flashback mod included 🎬

![Flashback mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cb77af1841e3c9e50adf197f567d75fc3f9f93b9.jpeg)

- **Flashback is a powerful cinematic recording and editing mod for Minecraft. It captures everything that happens in the world (movements, blocks, mobs) in real time behind the scenes. Then, using an in-game timeline, you can rewind and apply camera angles, slow motion, and zoom to create epic videos.**

![Bar 7](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a15ba9e8995146a21985dc13700225c3ccc3c002.png)
